# AgentBeats Lambda (Vendor Copy)

This is a vendor copy of the official `LambdaLabsML/agentbeats-lambda` repository at the pinned commit recorded in `COMMIT_PIN.txt`.

## Read-only policy
Do not modify vendor code for Purple Vanguard (PV) logic. Any PV-specific changes belong outside this vendor directory.

## How to update
1. Re-copy the upstream repository at a newer pinned commit.
2. Replace the contents of this directory with the new vendor copy.
3. Update `COMMIT_PIN.txt` to reflect the new commit and date.

## Purpose
Provide a deterministic, reproducible local mirror harness for evaluation and scoring.
